provenance.interpretation: The initial commit followed the local run by about two minutes, but the run did not record a Git SHA. Artifact identity is exact; original-training source identity is not cryptographically proven.

claim_boundaries: The checkpoint is trained only on tiny Shakespeare and is not a factual or general-purpose language model.
The int8 result is a weight-storage and dequantized-evaluation experiment, not an int8 execution kernel.
KV-cache timing is hardware- and run-dependent; local 200-token runs ranged from parity to 1.61x.
HellaSwag is an out-of-domain harness check and the recorded result is chance-level.
GPU retraining is seed-controlled but not promised to be bit-identical across PyTorch, CUDA, driver, or GPU versions.
The original training run predates a Git-SHA receipt; a later evaluation-only run is bound to clean source commit 148a0d28724c505790a8e79c85d61a8c06932f45.
